contract.objective: Make add in sum.mjs return the numeric sum of its two arguments for every sign of argument. Read README.md and sum.mjs; change only sum.mjs; run the exact host-supplied test command, read the diff, then stage and commit with the exact host command.
acceptanceCriteria: add(left, right) returns the numeric sum when both arguments are zero or positive.
add(left, right) returns the numeric sum when either argument is negative.
constraints: Change only sum.mjs; never change a test, the README, governance, settings or the commit message
Use only the declared test and exact add/commit commands for effectful shell operations; bounded read-only inspection follows the transport instructions

criteria.description: add(left, right) returns the numeric sum when both arguments are zero or positive.
add(left, right) returns the numeric sum when either argument is negative.

value.summary: AC-positive passes (focused test exit 0). AC-signed fails: sum.mjs computes left + Math.abs(right), discarding the sign of a negative right operand, so add(4,-7)=11 and add(-2,-3)=1 per the host contract-test witness. Repair sum.mjs to left + right.

reproductionSteps: Run node contract-test.mjs in a fresh confined copy of snapshot fnv1a64:0f6f8bc0a18f3286.

value.clause: add(left, right) returns the numeric sum when either argument is negative.

value.summary: Both criteria pass. sum.mjs now uses left + right (diff from a80c789 confirms the fix). Host live witnesses: node focused-test.mjs exit 0 covers zero/positive sums (AC-positive superficial); node contract-test.mjs exit 0 covers negative operands (AC-signed contract). No adverse evidence.
